title: Systems Engineer, AI Platforms - Global Capability Center
description:
Location: Gurugram, Haryāna, India
  
Date Posted: Oct 23, 2026

**About Alvarez & Marsal**

Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work - guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity - are why our people love working at A&M.

  

**The Team**

You will join the Global AI & Knowledge Organization (GAIKO), which leads A&M’s AI strategy, enablement, and knowledge infrastructure. Within GAIKO’s AI & Data organization, the AI Tools team manages the enterprise AI platforms practitioners use in their daily work. The team brings together business needs, vendor capabilities, and firm requirements to evaluate, introduce, and continually improve AI tools for thousands of global practitioners.

  

**How you will contribute**

As a **Systems Engineer**, you will provide technical direction and oversight for A&M’s Enterprise AI tools offering. You will help shape the technology strategy, manage and evolve existing platforms, evaluate new AI capabilities, oversee the enterprise API offering, and govern the MCP integrations and connectors that extend the core platforms.

  
  

This hands-on role requires strong technical expertise in Enterprise AI and SaaS platform management, APIs, Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, and the governance and controls needed to operate these capabilities securely at scale. You will assess capabilities from a technical standpoint, configure approved services, implement appropriate guardrails, and support reliable operation at scale.

  
  

You will work closely with the Product and colleagues across Architecture & Engineering, Enterprise IT, Security, Risk, and Legal to take capabilities from technical evaluation through pilot, deployment, and ongoing operation
  
  
1. **Manage Existing AI Platforms**

* **Platform administration:** Own configuration and administration of approved platforms such as Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor, including workspaces, feature settings, provisioning, groups, roles, and permissions; automate recurring administrative tasks.
* **Capability evaluation:** Define and apply technical evaluation criteria for new models, features, and agents within approved platforms, documenting capabilities, performance, and limitations to inform adoption decisions.
* **Controls and governance:** Identify security and risk control gaps, recommend guardrails, and work with compliance teams (security, risk, legal) to review risks and implement agreed controls for safely rollout capabilities
* **Deployment management:** Manage the deployment lifecycle for approved capabilities and configuration changes, including approval gates, controlled pilots, phased rollout, post-launch validation, and rollback procedures.
* **Service operations:** Maintain platform health, operational documentation, and support arrangements; coordinate incident resolution and vendor escalations.
  

  

**2. Manage the Enterprise API Offering**

* **Offering management:** Define and evolve the enterprise API offering, including supported services, technical configurations, service standards, and support requirements
* **Access governance:** Provision and govern access for approved teams and applications, managing accounts, projects, service identities, model permissions, credential lifecycles, and access ownership.
* **Consumption management:** Configure available usage limits, budgets, and alerts; monitor consumption and spend and recommend adjustments.
* **Service operations:** Support API consumers with onboarding, documentation, and troubleshooting; manage service reliability and coordinate responses to vendor changes, deprecations, and incidents.
  

  

**3. Manage MCPs and Connectors**

* **Integration enablement:** Assess and enable MCP connections and native connectors between core AI platforms and enterprise applications, data, and services, including the use of approved MCP wrappers for existing APIs.
* **Connection governance:** Configure and validate authentication, tool permissions, data boundaries, and permitted actions; conduct access reviews and maintain ownership, dependency, and configuration records.
* **Lifecycle and operations:** Manage connection health, changes, and support issues; assess capacity and scaling requirements and coordinate improvements or retirement.
  

  

**4. Evaluate New AI Tools**

* **Evaluation framework:** Establish reusable technical frameworks for assessing AI tools and capabilities, defining evaluation criteria, test scenarios, evidence requirements, and decision gates.
* **Technical evaluation:** Run hands-on security and risk assessments of candidate tools, models, and agents for technical fit and enterprise readiness, including performance, integration requirements, scalability, and supportability; document capabilities, limitations, and gaps.
* **Risk and control assessment:** Work with Architecture, Security, and other stakeholders to assess technical risks, identify control gaps, and agree requirements for enterprise approval.
* **Adoption recommendation:** Recommend whether and how to introduce new offerings, documenting the rationale, deployment options, dependencies, implementation effort, and operational requirements.
  

**Qualifications**

* (At least 8-10+ yearsof relevant professional experience in systems engineering, SaaS administration, Enterprise AI platform management, or a related discipline.
* Hands-on experience managing Enterprise AI platforms such as Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor, including configuration, access management, platform controls, and production support.
* Strong understanding of LLM platform capabilities, including models, features, and agents.
* Advanced knowledge of AI workflow design, security, and risk management
* Experience defining and applying technical evaluation criteria, with strong judgment in assessing architectural fit, performance, integration dependencies, controls, scalability, and deployment options.
* Strong working knowledge of REST APIs and webhook integrations, including authentication, service identities, credential management, usage limits, consumption monitoring, and troubleshooting.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of MCP, including client-server interactions, tool discovery and invocation, authentication, permission scopes, and how existing APIs can be exposed through MCP wrappers.
* Working knowledge of enterprise identity and access management, including SSO, SAML or OpenID Connect, SCIM provisioning, and role-based access controls.
* Ability to use administrative consoles, logs, API testing tools, and lightweight scripts in Python, PowerShell, JavaScript/TypeScript, or a comparable language for diagnostics and operational automation.
* Experience managing SaaS service lifecycles, including controlled pilots, release testing, deployment, change management, monitoring, incident resolution, vendor escalation, and retirement.
* Strong troubleshooting and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical findings, communicate controls and guardrails, document operational procedures, and work effectively across product, engineering, IT, and security teams.
* Experience supporting MCP services at enterprise scale, including hosted service dependencies, capacity planning, and operational efficiency
* Familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Graph, Microsoft 365 integrations, or Power Automate.
* Experience with risk monitoring and enterprise controls such as data loss prevention, audit logging, retention, and access reviews.
* Experience in consulting, professional services, or another environment with complex client-data requirements.
  

**Your journey at A&M**

We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. The possibilities are endless for high-performing and passionate professionals.

**Culture & Values**
--------------------

At Alvarez & Marsal, our core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity guide everything we do, shaping a culture rooted in entrepreneurship, impact, and integrity. We trust our people to take ownership early, contribute to meaningful challenges, and drive results that matter. We empower growth and champion diverse perspectives. Above all, we value doing the right thing. For those ready to roll up their sleeves, lead with integrity, and be difference makers, this is where it starts.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
------------------------------

It is Alvarez & Marsal’s practice to provide and promote equal opportunity in employment, compensation, and other terms and conditions of employment without discrimination because of race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, sex or gender, gender identity or gender expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, physical or mental disability, family medical history, genetic information or other protected medical condition, political affiliation, or any other characteristic protected by and in accordance with applicable laws. Employees and Applicants can find A&M policy statements and additional information by region here.

**Unsolicited Resumes from Third-Party Recruiters**
---------------------------------------------------

Please note that as per A&M policy, we do not accept unsolicited resumes from third-party recruiters unless such recruiters are engaged to provide candidates for a specified opening. Any employment agency, person or entity that submits an unsolicited resume does so with the understanding that A&M will have the right to hire that applicant at its discretion without any fee owed to the submitting employment agency, person or entity.

title: Staff CPQ Systems Engineer
description:
### **About Us**

With electric vehicles expected to be nearly 30% of new vehicle sales by 2025 and more than 50% by 2040, electric mobility is becoming a reality. ChargePoint (NYSE: CHPT) is at the center of this revolution, powering one of the world's leading EV charging networks and a comprehensive set of hardware, software and mobile solutions for every charging need across North America and Europe. We bring together drivers, businesses, automakers, policymakers, utilities and other stakeholders to make e-mobility a global reality.

Since our founding in 2007, ChargePoint has focused solely on making the transition to electric easy for businesses, fleets and drivers. ChargePoint offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to create an all-electric future and a trillion-dollar market.

At ChargePoint, we foster a positive and productive work environment by committing to live our values of Be Courageous, Charge Together, Love our Customers, Operate with Openness, and Relentlessly Pursue Awesome. These values guide how we show up every day, align, and work together to build a brighter future for all of us.

Join the team that is building the EV charging industry and make your mark on how people and goods will get everywhere they need to go, in any context, for generations to come.

### **Reports To**

Salesforce CPQ Architect and Delivery Lead  
  
**Role Summary**
  
ChargePoint is seeking an experienced Quote-to-Cash (QTC) Systems Engineer to join our dynamic Sales Operations team. In this role, you will apply deep CPQ expertise to shape the underlying principles of product configuration, pricing, approvals, and revenue recognition that power our global sales engine. This is a hands-on builder role where you will partner closely with Sales, Finance, and RevOps to design scalable quoting and pricing solutions, evaluate platforms, and drive cutting-edge AI tooling into our workflows to relentlessly pursue awesome outcomes for our customers.  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**
  
You will serve as a technical anchor for our CPQ infrastructure, translating complex business quoting and pricing requirements into robust, scalable technical solutions. Day-to-day, you will manage end-to-end CPQ functionality—from configuration and automation to custom development—while actively contributing to platform evaluation and migration strategies. Success in your first 6–12 months means seamlessly integrating AI-assisted tooling into our workflows, stabilizing and scaling our pricing models, and establishing yourself as a trusted technical partner across our enterprise Agile environment.  
**What You Will Bring to ChargePoint**

* **Translate** complex quoting and pricing requirements from Sales, Finance, and RevOps into technical solutions, covering configuration, automation, and custom development.
* **Design** and implement scalable pricing models, product catalogs, discount structures, and advanced approval workflows for subscriptions, co-terming, amendments, and renewals.
* **Own** CPQ functionality end-to-end, actively managing configurator logic, pricing rules, approval chains, and output templates.
* **Leverage** AI-assisted and vibe coding tools to build, prototype, and iterate rapidly, driving efficiency in Salesforce or alternative platforms.
* **Lead** critical gap analyses and create comprehensive as-is/to-be documentation to support platform evaluation and migration strategies.
* **Architect** seamless integration designs connecting quoting systems with ERP, billing, and order management platforms.
* **Collaborate** across an Agile environment, actively supporting successful go-lives, leading user training sessions, and documenting system builds.
* **Drive** continuous improvement in deployment processes using release management tools, CI/CD pipelines, and Git-based version control.
* **Partner** with cross-functional leaders, comfortably whiteboarding complex solutions with architects while translating processes for sales executives.

**Requirements**

* 6-10 years of experience implementing complex CPQ solutions, with meaningful time spent on Salesforce CPQ or comparable enterprise platforms.
* Deep understanding of CPQ fundamentals, including pricing waterfall logic, multi-tier discounting, subscription models, advanced approvals, co-terming, and renewals.
* Development fluency in at least one major quoting platform (e.g., Salesforce Apex, LWC, SOQL/SOSL, Flow Builder) or equivalent.
* Hands-on experience integrating quoting systems with enterprise ERP and billing ecosystems.
* Proficiency in release management using tools such as Copado, AutoRabit, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Exceptional communication skills with the ability to articulate technical strategies to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Demonstrated use of AI-assisted coding environments (e.g., Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Replit Agent) to build or prototype quoting solutions, including a strong perspective on where these tools accelerate delivery and where guardrails are needed.
* Background working in a high-growth B2B SaaS or hardware-software company managing deal complexity (enterprise licensing, channel/partner quoting, multi-currency).
* Experience with Salesforce Revenue Cloud Advanced (RCA) or active participation in a large-scale CPQ migration project.

**Location**
  
Gurgaon, India — Remote

We are committed to an inclusive and diverse team. ChargePoint is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status or any legally protected status.

If there is a match between your experiences/skills and the Company needs, we will contact you directly.

ChargePoint is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that welcomes and supports all qualified individuals. In alignment with this commitment, we ensure that persons with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodations throughout the employment process.

If you need a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, or to access any other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact us at **accommodations@chargepoint.com**.

ChargePoint is an equal opportunity employer.  
Applicants only - Recruiting agencies do not contact.

title: Senior Systems Engineer (Presales) - Netops
description:
**Solution Architect – Secure Networking – India**

**Location:** Gurgaon / NCR
  

**Department:** SME Engineering – Secure Networking  



**About Fortinet**

Fortinet has been founded on the principle of converging networking and security into a unified solution. Over the past 12 years, Fortinet has significantly expanded its Wired and Wireless networking portfolio through organic innovation and strategic acquisitions.


This growth has been recognized by Gartner®, which positioned Fortinet as a **Leader in the 2024 and 2025 Magic Quadrant™ for Enterprise Wired and Wireless LAN Infrastructure** .


If you have **12\+ years of hands\-on experience designing, implementing, and troubleshooting enterprise Wired and Wireless networking solutions** , this is an opportunity to join Fortinet's Subject Matter Expert (SME) team and take your networking expertise into the next level of Network Security.  



**Role Overview**

As a **Solution Architect – Secure Networking** , you will be part of the SME Engineering team supporting the India \& SAARC region.


You will work closely with Account Teams and Field Systems Engineers to position Fortinet's Secure Networking portfolio, including:


* Network Access Control (NAC)
* Wireless
* Enterprise Switching
* Identity \& Access Management (AAA)
* Voice Solutions
* ZTNA
* SD\-Branch

The role involves providing **second\-level pre\-sales technical support** , leading complex customer engagements, conducting POCs and demonstrations, and acting as a technical bridge between the field teams and Fortinet's Consulting Systems Engineering (CSE) organization.
